go_hold.subject: Bidline paid Estimating Kit
go_hold.rationale: Real, large audience and verified spreadsheet behaviour, plus paid bundles at $9-$109 on Etsy and Gumroad. But the free-template market is saturated and earlier FORGE research ranked a trades estimate pack last. Proceed only with a differentiated kit; keep investment small until first-party sales prove demand.
go_hold.falsifying_test: If the kit is live, checkout works and Bidline gets at least 300 organic sessions to the kit page within 60 days of launch with zero sales, move Bidline to hold and shift Stage 2 to Quilt Plan Kit. Thresholds are owner-adjustable decision rules, not forecasts.

positioning.one_line: Small US residential contractors do price jobs in spreadsheets and lose money on markup, overhead and labour-hour mistakes, but basic estimate templates are given away free by software vendors and dozens of AI-built sites, so Bidline only earns money if its paid kit sells the profit loop (overhead recovery, labour hours, estimate vs actual) rather than a template.
